csv_project_name: A/E for Student Apartments Housing and Innovation Hub
csv_scope_of_work: Northeast Ohio Medical University (NEOMED), 4209 St Rt 44, PO Box 95, Rootstown, Ohio, 44272, requests interested firms to submit qualifications for Architecture and Engineering (A/E) services for Graduate Student Apartment Housing and First Floor Innovation Hub facility located on the Rootstown campus. The project site is located north of the Medical Office Building and east of The Village apartments. Professional services are requested for programing, design and construction administration and related consulting services for this new facility. The building layout has been conceptualized from a recently completed master plan study. The L shaped structure will be approximately 150,000 square feet including a basement level for mechanical and future programming. Key features of this facility include a first-floor innovation hub that will be an open area for collaborative programming by NEOMED. The additional four floors will be dedicated to 130 single unit apartments for graduate student housing. Each 500 sf unit will include furnished bedroom, bathroom, kitchen, living area, and washer-dryer.
